scenario: xfs mount at /mnt/xfsproj whose mountinfo major:minor (259:2) differs from the probed path st_dev (8:16) must be reported as unknown / device_mismatch instead of an xfs quota-option verdict.

fixture.mountinfo:
1 0 259:3 / / rw,relatime shared:1 - xfs /dev/nvme0n1p3 rw,attr2,inode64,noquota
25 30 0:22 / /proc rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime shared:12 - proc proc rw
29 25 0:30 /@home /home rw,relatime shared:1 - btrfs /dev/mapper/root rw,compress=zstd:3,ssd,discard=async,space_cache=v2,subvolid=257,subvol=/@home
244 33 259:2 / /mnt/xfsproj rw,relatime - xfs /dev/nvme0n1p2 rw,attr2,inode64,noquota

rationale: Derivation from contract.md section C2 only (contract frozen at lane commit 4dc80c1be48308075e83af17f15fbfe7e95e6cb8), plus the named kernel sources. (1) Mount resolution: the probed path is /mnt/xfsproj/work with realpath /mnt/xfsproj/work. Contract candidate rule (mount point equals realpath, or is '/', or realpath starts with mount point + '/') admits the root line '/' and the xfs line '/mnt/xfsproj'; longest mount point wins, so the chosen mount is '/mnt/xfsproj' with fstype 'xfs' and mountinfo major:minor '259:2'. Source anchor: proc.rst section 3.5 (S082) lines 1947-1957 give the field order (1) mount ID, (2) parent ID, (3) major:minor, (4) root, (5) mount point, (6) mount options, (n..m) optional fields, (m+1) separator, (m+2) filesystem type, (m+3) mount source, (m+4) super options; line 1949 defines field (3) as 'value of st_dev for files on filesystem'. (2) Device check: contract section C2 states 'If chosen fstype is not btrfs and its major:minor != the path st_dev -> unknown basis device_mismatch'. Chosen fstype is xfs (not btrfs) and 259:2 != 8:16, so the per-path verdict is quota_state 'unknown' with basis 'device_mismatch'; enforcement 'n/a' follows the contract table convention that every unknown-state row carries enforcement 'n/a'. The xfs rows of the contract table are not reached: the super options 'rw,attr2,inode64,noquota' would otherwise have selected xfs_noquota_option, which is exactly the verdict the device identity check must suppress. Source anchors for those (unreached) rows: xfs.rst (S077) lines 170-184 (noquota; uquota/usrquota/uqnoenforce/quota; gquota/grpquota/gqnoenforce; pquota/prjquota/pqnoenforce) and xfs_super.c (S078) xfs_showargs lines 238-254 (usrquota/uqnoenforce, prjquota/pqnoenforce, grpquota/gqnoenforce, noquota). (3) btrfs contrast: btrfs inode.c (S081) line 8242 'stat->dev = BTRFS_I(inode)->root->anon_dev' shows a btrfs subvolume reports a per-subvolume anonymous st_dev that legitimately differs from the mountinfo major:minor, which is why the contract exempts btrfs (device_check 'btrfs_subvolume_skipped'). For a non-btrfs filesystem the mountinfo major:minor is the filesystem's st_dev (proc.rst line 1949), so a difference means the probed path is not on the chosen filesystem and no quota verdict about that filesystem may be asserted. (4) Verdict precedence: contract section C2 'else any unknown -> 2 QUOTA_STATE_UNKNOWN'; the single probed path is unknown and none is enabled, so exit 2 and finding_id 'QUOTA_STATE_UNKNOWN'. Contract gaps deliberately not asserted by this case: the contract names no device_check token for a non-btrfs mismatch (only 'match' and 'btrfs_subvolume_skipped' are named), and it does not state in so many words that the device_mismatch clause preempts the fstype classification table; this case asserts only the six contract-comparison fields (path, fstype, mount_point, quota_state, enforcement, basis) and derives enforcement 'n/a' by the table's own unknown-state convention.
